data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for the SumUp SDK to connect to terminals and accept card payments.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to connect to a SumUp card reader terminal or use Tap-to-Pay on Android and iOS. It handles merchant login, settings configuration, and processing card checkouts.
use_when: You need to accept physical card payments or Tap-to-Pay using SumUp hardware or supported devices.
Building a point-of-sale (POS) application in Flutter for Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are implementing in-app purchases or subscriptions for digital goods.
You need an online payment gateway like Stripe rather than in-person card readers.
strengths: Supports both traditional SumUp card readers and Tap-to-Pay on Android and iOS.
Provides straightforward methods for initialization, login, and checkout.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and native SDK requirements (such as specific Android minSdk and Kotlin versions for Tap-to-Pay).
Android Tap-to-Pay requires private Maven credentials.
data.setup_notes: Requires a SumUp merchant account, Affiliate Key, configuring native deployment targets (iOS 16+, Android minSdk 26 or 30 for Tap-to-Pay), Java 17, and specific build configurations.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Stripe if you need to process online payments or use Stripe Terminal instead of SumUp.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Adyen if your integration requires the Adyen payment platform.
